standard_prerequisites.name: The functor R\Gamma_T of sections with support in a specialization-stable subset T and its right adjointness to the inclusion of the category of modules supported in T
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: The author's section on more general supports, in which the counted statement occurs
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the composite of the two support functors with the functor for the intersection of the supports.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Grothendieck spectral sequence of a composition of derived functors, in the form recorded in the chapter on derived categories
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked twice in the counted proof (statement line 1138-1139 and proof line 1158-1159) as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the spectral sequence from the identification R\Gamma_{T \cap T'} = R\Gamma_T \circ R\Gamma_{T'}.

core_obligations: Identify the composite functor: using adjointness of R\Gamma_T and then of R\Gamma_{T'}, the proof shows that for every object of D_{T \cap T'}(A) the two displayed Hom groups coincide, so that the composite has the stated universal property (proof lines 1143-1150)

Identify the functor computed by the composite: choosing a bounded below complex of injectives representing the given object, the proof observes that the zeroth local cohomology of the complex is again a complex of injectives representing the first factor, hence the iterated functor is the functor for the intersection and lands in the correct subcategory (proof lines 1151-1157)
Produce the sequence: the equality R\Gamma_{T \cap T'} = R\Gamma_T \circ R\Gamma_{T'} is then fed into the spectral sequence lemma referenced in the statement (proof lines 1157-1159)
proof_roadmap: 先用 RΓ_T 与 RΓ_{T'} 的伴随性，对 D_{T∩T'}(A) 中的对象 E 算出 Hom(E, RΓ_T(RΓ_{T'}(K))) = Hom(E,K) = Hom(E, RΓ_{T∩T'}(K))；再用有界下有内射分解，验证 H^0_T(H^0_{T'}(J^∙)) 确实表示复合函子。
由此得到 RΓ_{T∩T'} = RΓ_T ∘ RΓ_{T'}，代入 Grothendieck 谱序列的引理即得所述 E_2 页。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement constructs the spectral sequence whose E_2 page is the local cohomology with support in one specialization-stable subset applied to the local cohomology with support in another, converging to the local cohomology with support in the intersection, for bounded below complexes (author lemma at source lines 1130-1140, label lemma-local-cohomology-ss). The proof (source lines 1142-1160) does not invoke the general Grothendieck sequence blindly: it first identifies the composite functor by adjointness through a displayed sequence of Hom equalities (proof lines 1143-1150), then verifies by an injective resolution that the composite is computed by the iterated zeroth local cohomology and lands in the category of modules supported in the intersection (proof lines 1151-1157), and only then invokes the general spectral sequence lemma. The two identifications are the content. H2.
